'''Lightning spires''' were used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] to protect their cities, equipment and personnel from lightning strikes, which constantly ravaged the planet's surface. Designed by former commander in the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] [[Renigus Wight]], the spires towered above the jungles of Dromund Kaas and not only attracted the deadly lightning strikes away from the ground, but also harnessed their energy to power their cities.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lightning spires appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' throughout Dromund Kaas.
